segments.title: Pepito Sign-On & First Mayoral Term
segments.notes: Case Blackwell opens as Pepito the dog/EP, assumes mayoral control of Renerton in They Are Billions, bulldozes hospitals/schools, consolidates police, and fields press questions.

segments.title: Election 2032: Jeb Nogget Elected
segments.notes: Low-turnout election pits Munch, Jeb, Loop Chef, Peter, and KP against Pepito; Jeb wins on bulldoze-industry platform.

segments.title: Jeb's Term: 600k Milestone & Cascade Disasters
segments.notes: Jeb achieves 600,000 citizens, then tornado, Bowser/Godzilla, fires, and nuclear meltdown devastate city; Jeb raps campaign plea.

segments.title: Election 2034: Hot Dog Sandwich Wins
segments.notes: Three-candidate race (Jeb, Munch, Hot Dog) ends in 100% Hot Dog victory amid ongoing explosions.

segments.title: Hot Dog Mayoral Term & Peter Gibbon Press Conference
segments.notes: Hot Dog mayor raps, naps; Peter Gibbon calls press conference, shadow cabal demands souls, Hamtaro released, Munch forced to rebuild.

segments.title: Munch Rebuilds from 10 Citizens
segments.notes: Munch declares extra-judicial powers, rebuilds Renerton from population 10 in They Are Billions, learns controls, establishes defenses.

segments.title: Election 2036: Xena Warrior Princess Elected
segments.notes: Ballot includes Elgin Draco, Alyssa Lister, Munch, Hamtaro, Xena; Xena wins after technical chair difficulties.

segments.title: Xena's Term & City Collapse
segments.notes: Xena manages resources, fights zombie hordes, builds walls and army; accidental soldier misclick triggers total wipe, emergency election called.

segments.title: Sign-Off & Raid
segments.notes: Case reflects on Renerton's tourism boom among adventurers, mentions meth crisis, raids Spinachi.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: anchor. Hosts entire broadcast as Pepito impression, plays They Are Billions as Renerton mayor across multiple terms.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivers sign-on at top of hour via Case's voice; referenced as cheese sludge commercial producer and Renerton Gold beer promoter.

characters.name: Jeb Nogget
characters.notes: recurring. Wins 2032 election, serves as mayor until disaster cascade, references wood shop and father trapped in board.

characters.name: Xena Warrior Princess
characters.notes: guest mayor. Wins 2036 election, manages rebuild from tents, commands princess warriors, loses city to misclick.

characters.name: Crum
characters.notes: recurring. Heavily referenced as former mayor ('Crub'), gambling debt to Rock-afire gorilla mocked; Pepito claims 'twice the Crumb' growth.

characters.name: Munch
characters.notes: recurring. Referenced as tsunami-era mayor, 2032/2034 candidate, forced to rebuild from population 10, claims founding hero status.

characters.name: Peter Gibbon
characters.notes: news stowaway. Mentioned living in walls with rats, delivers life-hack for wall-dwelling food delivery, calls press conference as former mayor.

lore_notes.fact: Renerton Gold beer EPA-cleared for cleaning vinyl housing and deemed safe to drink.
Peter Gibbon lives in studio walls with rats; uses 'help I'm being attacked' delivery hack for free food.
Renerton practices river burials; river dissolves bodies quickly and contains 'Nickelodeon silver'.
Renerton considers itself a feudal state with Godzilla as campaign donor and personal friend.
Crum's gambling debt to Rock-afire animatronic gorilla still referenced ('Sorry, Crub').
Jeb Nogget elected mayor of Renerton in 2032 election.
Xena Warrior Princess elected mayor of Renerton in 2036 election.
Renerton population reached 600,000 then collapsed to 10 citizens after disaster cascade.
Mayoring software identified as They Are Billions; Munch claims founding hero status.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News broadcasts a special Renerton mayoral simulation from the They Are Billions city-builder. Pepito opens as acting mayor, achieves 600,000 citizens through aggressive hospital bulldozing, then loses office to Jeb Nogget. Jeb's term ends in a cascade of tornadoes, Godzilla attacks, and nuclear fire. A hot dog sandwich wins the next election unanimously. After the hot dog fails, Peter Gibbon and a shadow cabal force Munch to rebuild from ten survivors. Munch stabilizes the wasteland until Xena Warrior Princess wins a subsequent election, but her term ends when a misclicked soldier triggers total civilian slaughter. The broadcast concludes with a raid to Spinachi.
